values.note: $22 electric, $27 electric with direct water; plus the park's $3 booking fee, once per stay, on Campspot. A $5 fee to lock a specific site is optional.

fees.source: https://vigoparks.org/camping/ ('Camping Electric - $22', 'Camping Electric/Water - $27', '$5 lock site fee ... optional'); https://www.campspot.com/book/prairiecreekparkin/ (site lists $25 and $30 with the $3 fee), read 2026-10-31

hookups.source: https://www.campspot.com/book/prairiecreekparkin/ (RV site types: 30-Amp, 50-Amp, Water Hook-Up on 13 sites), read 2026-10-31

sites.source: https://www.campspot.com/book/prairiecreekparkin/ (1 accessible + 25 electric + 13 electric/water + 2 primitive, listed RV lengths up to 60 ft), read 2026-10-31

facilities.source: https://vigoparks.org/prairie-creek-park-2/ ('A modern shower house, restrooms, and dump station'), read 2026-10-31

values.note: Reservations open February 2. Campers with reservations must check in online.

note: Vigo County park near Terre Haute, with sites in a maple grove; a 13-acre lake and a pond lie within the park, the lake about 120 m through woods from the nearest loop. --Claude
summary: $22-27 confirmed; 42 -> 41 sites (Campspot count), max rig 60 added; season, hookups, facilities confirmed; 'beside the lake' corrected in note.
flags: PIN ~350 m off: stored 39.28848,-87.46854 is on French Drive at the park frontage. Campground loops are at about 39.2853,-87.4695 per imagery and the park map.

WATERFRONT: Campspot lists 'Waterfront' as a park feature, and the old note said 'beside a 13-acre lake'. Plotted against the county's park map, the electric loops sit in woods with about 120 m of canopy to the lake's NE shore; no site is on or views the water. Stored 'not waterfront' holds.
PUBLIC: an ordinary night can be booked by anyone on Campspot. Operator says approximately 40 modern sites, Campspot counts 39 RV + 2 primitive.
No note or fee change on season: the 11-02 closing is Campspot's record only; the county page gives only the April 1 start.
